summary: Steel lookout near Pineville, KY, described by federal surveyors in 1950; listed as removed, and no source describes the site today.

facts.design: Four-legged steel tower with a square cab on top, painted gray
facts.status_note: Listed as removed; no source describes the site today.

events.note: Coast and Geodetic Survey first observed and described the station

evidence.supports: about 4 miles northeast of Pineville on the Pine Mountain range
evidence.quote: STATION IS LOCATED ABOUT 4 MILES NORTHEAST OF PINEVILLE ON THE PINE

evidence.supports: four-legged steel structure about 90 feet high, painted gray, square cab on top
evidence.quote: IT IS A FOUR LEGGED STEEL STRUCTURE ABOUT 90 FEET HIGH, PAINTED GREY WITH A SQUARE CAB ON TOP

evidence.supports: directions begin at the junction of U.S. Highways 25E and 119, about a mile south of Pineville, and run up forks and hill roads
evidence.quote: TO REACH THE STATION FROM THE JUNCTION OF U.S. HIGHWAYS 25E AND 119 ABOUT ONE MILE SOUTH OF PINEVILLE

evidence.supports: first observed and described by the Coast and Geodetic Survey in 1950
survey line of about 3.3 feet from triangulation station Bird to the tower base
evidence.quote: A TRAVERSE CONNECTION WAS MADE FROM TRIANGULATION STATION BIRD AND THE DISTANCE WAS FOUND TO BE 3.3 FEET (1.00 METERS)

evidence.supports: the survey point observed from the traverse is the intersection of the tower's base
evidence.quote: THE POINT MEASURED TO AND OBSERVED ON WAS THE INTERSECTION OF THE BASE OF THE TOWER

evidence.supports: directions run up forks and hill roads to the tower
evidence.quote: KEEP LEFT FORK UP HILL FOR 0.3 MILE TO A LARGE FLAT ROCK

evidence.supports: survey record still lists the station with a current position; does not say whether the tower stands

sources.title: Survey mark GA3582, Bird Branch Lookout Tower

notes_for_editor: The survey description (1950) is the only substantive source and it describes the structure, not its construction date, so no built event is recorded. The record's height of 27.4 m matches the survey's 'about 90 feet' (27.43 m). The record's coordinates agree with the NGS position for GA3582 (36.7640 N, 83.6353 W). No agency is named by any source. The 'Removed' label on the Forest Lookouts Bird Branch page (not the index, which lists only 'Bell County') is the only fate evidence; no removal date or cause was found. Public access to the site is unknown.
